description: Audit pipeline: the single recordAuditEvent writer + sanitizeMetadata, then migrate all 28 existing tx.auditLog.create write sites and the audit readers to audit_events, and retype the pass timeline builder. Preserves the in-tx atomic write guarantee (campass_app has INSERT on audit_events). Keeps the existing /audit-logs endpoint working with legacy + catalogue action query params and a pinned response shape. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the catalogue, the audit_events table/client, and the regenerated Prisma client). Maps to impl-plan.md steps 5-6.
steps: Step 5: Create apps/api/src/services/audit.ts with recordAuditEvent(input, tx?) per design 4.3: throw if input.action not in AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET; write via (tx ?? privilegedPrisma).auditEvent.create mapping action/result/actorUserId/actorRoleKey/institutionId/actorMembershipId/resourceType/resourceId/supportGrantId/requestRef/metadata; run metadata through sanitizeMetadata (allow-list scalars, truncate strings, drop keys matching password|token|secret|mfa*|qr*). Add apps/api/src/services/__tests__/audit.test.ts: unknown key throws; uses passed tx else privilegedPrisma; sanitizer drops secret-like keys and truncates.

Step 6a: Migrate the 28 write sites keeping the in-tx pattern. admin.ts (17: lines ~437,511,647,687,722,756,852,1036,1230,1351,1394,1474,1535,1614,1663,1729,1790), guard.ts (5: ~139,194,273,464,600), hod.ts (4: ~219,287,359,444), student.ts (2: ~214,301). Replace each tx.auditLog.create({ data:{ actorId, institutionId, action:<ENUM>, targetId, targetType, metadata } }) with await recordAuditEvent({ action: <catalogue key via LEGACY_AUDIT_ACTION_MAP[<ENUM>] or the literal>, result: 'SUCCESS' (or DENIED/ERROR where the handler already branches on failure), actorUserId: userId, actorRoleKey: request.auth?.roles[0] ?? request.user.role, institutionId, actorMembershipId: request.auth?.membershipId, resourceType, resourceId, requestRef: request.id, metadata }, tx). EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE at admin.ts:1790 and hod.ts:219 -> campus_movement.pass.override.

Step 6b: Migrate readers. admin.ts GET /audit-logs: switch to tx.auditEvent.findMany/count under withTenant; DROP the where.actor.institutionId join filter and rely on RLS tenant_isolation_select on the event row's own institutionId (design 4.4 — do NOT reintroduce the actor join, it would re-hide break-glass rows); include: { actorUser: { select: { id, email, role } } }; keep the { logs, pagination } envelope; normalize the action query param (valid catalogue key -> use; legacy enum in LEGACY_AUDIT_ACTION_MAP -> translate; else 400 { error: 'unknown action filter' }).
Step 6c: Migrate the hod.ts and student.ts pass-timeline readers (tx.auditLog.findMany filtered targetType:'GatePass') to tx.auditEvent.findMany filtered resourceType:'GatePass'.

Step 6d: Update apps/api/src/services/pass-lifecycle.ts: retype AuditLogLike.action to string (+ optional result?: AuditResult) and change the revoke filter from l.action === 'PASS_REVOKED' to l.action === 'campus_movement.pass.revoked'.

Step 6e: Add apps/api/src/services/__tests__/no-straggler-audit.test.ts: assert zero tx.auditLog.create occurrences under apps/api/src/routes/** (scope may also include services/**, which starts at 0); AND assert auditEvent.update / auditEvent.delete / auditEvent.deleteMany never appear anywhere under apps/api/src.

Step 6f: Update the mocked tests that assert the old auditLog.create shape or the old /audit-logs response (admin-config-calendar.integration.test.ts, pass-revocation-summary.integration.test.ts) to the migrated auditEvent/recordAuditEvent shape and the pinned response fields (action is a string catalogue key, result present, actorUser relation).
acceptance_criteria: recordAuditEvent throws on an unknown action key, uses the passed tx when present (else privilegedPrisma), and sanitizeMetadata drops secret-like keys and truncates long strings (unit tests pass).
Zero tx.auditLog.create remain under apps/api/src/routes/**; no auditEvent.update/delete/deleteMany anywhere under apps/api/src (no-straggler test passes).
GET /audit-logs still returns { logs, pagination }; action filter accepts both a legacy enum value (translated) and a catalogue key; an unknown value returns 400.
The migrated audit writes still commit inside the tenant withTenant transaction (atomic with the business mutation).
cd apps/api && npx vitest run keeps all 142 baseline tests green (migrated-shape mocked suites updated) plus the new audit/no-straggler tests.
verification: cd apps/api && npx vitest run   (all tests green)
findings:
WRITER (apps/api/src/services/audit.ts): recordAuditEvent(input, tx?) + sanitizeMetadata exactly per design §4.3. Throws on an action not in AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET; client = tx ?? privilegedPrisma; writes auditEvent.create with the full field map. sanitizeMetadata allow-lists scalars (string|number|boolean|null), truncates strings to 500 chars, and DROPS any key matching /password|token|secret|mfa|qr/i. Nested objects/arrays/undefined are dropped (never persisted). metadata is cast to Prisma.InputJsonValue | undefined to satisfy the JSON input type. FEAT-003 platform/pre-tenant writes must OMIT tx (falls back to privilegedPrisma, required for institutionId=null rows); break-glass accessed-writes are a SEPARATE privileged recordAuditEvent after withSupportGrant returns (design §6.3), NOT inside the read-only tx.

WRITE SITES: all 28 tx.auditLog.create migrated to recordAuditEvent(..., tx), in-tx atomic pattern preserved. admin.ts 17, guard.ts 5, hod.ts 4, student.ts 2. Each call derives actorRoleKey: request.auth?.roles[0] ?? request.user.role, actorMembershipId: request.auth?.membershipId, requestRef: request.id, result: 'SUCCESS'. actorId->actorUserId, targetId->resourceId, targetType->resourceType, metadata preserved. EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE (admin.ts /emergency-override + hod.ts /emergency-override) -> campus_movement.pass.override. guard.ts PASS_EXPIRED keeps actorUserId = pass.student.userId (the student), not the acting guard, matching the pre-migration actorId. NOTE: all current write sites are SUCCESS happy-path; no handler branched on failure, so no DENIED/ERROR writes were introduced (FEAT-003 adds those on the platform/grant paths).

READERS: admin.ts GET /audit-logs -> tx.auditEvent.findMany/count under withTenant. DROPPED the where.actor.institutionId join (design §4.4 — relies on RLS tenant_isolation_select on the event row's own institutionId; do NOT reintroduce or break-glass rows re-hide). include: { actorUser: { select: { id, email, role } } }. Response envelope { logs, pagination } unchanged. action query param normalized: valid catalogue key -> use as-is; legacy enum in LEGACY_AUDIT_ACTION_MAP -> translated; otherwise 400 { error: 'unknown action filter' }. hod.ts + student.ts pass-timeline readers -> tx.auditEvent.findMany filtered resourceType:'GatePass' + resourceId + action.in[6 campus_movement.pass.* keys] (translated from the old 6 PASS_* enum list).

PASS-LIFECYCLE (services/pass-lifecycle.ts): AuditLogLike.action retyped AuditAction->string, added optional result?: AuditResult (imported from @campusgate/db). Revoke filter changed l.action === 'PASS_REVOKED' -> 'campus_movement.pass.revoked'. The AuditAction enum import was removed from this file.

TESTS ADDED: services/__tests__/audit.test.ts (unknown-key throw; tx-vs-privileged selection; null defaults; sanitizer drops secret keys + truncates). IMPORTANT vitest gotcha: the mock spy for privilegedPrisma.auditEvent.create MUST be created with vi.hoisted (a plain top-level const is not initialized when the hoisted vi.mock factory runs -> 'Cannot access before initialization'). services/__tests__/no-straggler-audit.test.ts: (1) zero /\bauditLog\.create\b/ under routes/** and services/** (excludes *.test.ts / *.property.test.ts — the mocked prisma.auditLog.create spy in services/__tests__/allowance-integration.test.ts is legitimate and intentionally NOT migrated), (2) zero /\bauditEvent\.(update|delete|deleteMany)\b/ anywhere under src (append-only).

MOCKED TESTS UPDATED (shape migration): admin-config-calendar.integration.test.ts and pass-revocation-summary.integration.test.ts — the mocked @campusgate/db now exposes auditEvent (create [+ findMany for the timeline reader]) instead of auditLog; MockFn types + .mockResolvedValue calls renamed accordingly. These suites do NOT mock @campusgate/shared, so AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET validation runs against the real catalogue and the migrated action keys pass.

VERIFICATION: `cd apps/api && npx vitest run` = 159 passed / 20 files (148 FEAT-001 baseline + 9 audit + 2 no-straggler). Root `npm run build` passes (api tsc clean + prisma generate + web). No DB/migration change in FEAT-002 (FEAT-001 already created audit_events + client). No .env touched.

FOR FEAT-003: import { recordAuditEvent } from '../services/audit.js'. For platform actions call recordAuditEvent(input) with NO tx (uses privilegedPrisma; set institutionId null for pure-platform, or the target tenant for grant-scoped). Use result: 'DENIED'/'ERROR' on the gated/failure branches (suspended-institution access, failed step-up). The GET /audit-logs backward-compat action translation + the LEGACY_AUDIT_ACTION_MAP are reused for the platform Audit Explorer (design §7.5). Platform actors have actorMembershipId null and actorRoleKey 'SUPER_ADMIN'.
